director.text: Riya, main Asha hoon, tumhari AI teacher. Chalo, shuru karein?
samajh nahi aaya

Aaj hum kisi shape ke chaaron taraf ka poora kinaara naapenge. Cricket ki pitch socho, lagbhag 20 m lambi aur 3 m chaudi. Ek kone se chalo, kinaare-kinaare pitch ghoomkar wahin lauto. Jitna chale, utna pitch ka parimap hai. Yahi chakkar ab ek triangle par. Ab tak samajh aaya?
samajh nahi aaya

Theek hai, yahi baat seedhe tareeke se kehti hoon. Is triangle ki teen bhujayein hain, 4 cm, 5 cm aur 6 cm. Ek kone par ungli rakho aur kinaare par chalao: pehli bhuja, doosri, teesri, aur wapas usi kone par. Ungli jitna chali, wahi parimap hai. Ungli kone se chal ke wapas usi kone tak kul kitne cm chali?
director.card: Ungli kone se chal ke wapas usi kone tak kul kitne cm chali?

seams.form: Theek hai, yahi baat seedhe tareeke se kehti hoon.

director.text: 9 cm

9 cm sahi nahi hai. Ise ek alag tareeke se dekhte hain. Ab ek khet socho, kone P, Q, R, S, T. P par ungli rakho aur har bhuja ka naam lo jaise-jaise uski lambai jodte ho. Ek bhi bhuja chhooti toh jod adhoora. Jod tabhi poora hota hai jab tum wapas P par pahunchte ho. Yahan tak theek hai?

seams.form: Ise ek alag tareeke se dekhte hain.

director.text: thoda hindi mein samjhao

Haan, ise aur aasaan karke samjhaati hoon. Ek chowkidaar raat ko khet ke kinaare ghoomta hai aur har kone par seeti bajata hai. Jab tak woh pehle kone par lautke seeti na bajaye, chakkar poora nahi, aur beech ki har bhuja uski doori mein judti hai. Khet PQRST ki paanch bhujayein hain: PQ 8 m, QR 5 m, RS 7 m, ST 6 m, TP 3 m. Khet ka poora kinaara kitne metre ka hai?

director.text: 26 m nahi, yeh jawab theek nahi baitha. P se shuru karo aur PQ, QR, RS, ST, TP bolte jao. TP ke baad tum wapas P par ho. 8 m, 5 m, 7 m, 6 m aur 3 m bhujaon wale khet PQRST ka poora kinaara kitne metre ka hai?
director.card: Khet PQRST ki paanch bhujayein hain: PQ 8 m, QR 5 m, RS 7 m, ST 6 m, TP 3 m. Khet ka poora kinaara kitne metre ka hai?

director.text: Nahi, yeh theek nahi hai. Is sawaal ka jawab 29 m hai, kyunki P se wapas P tak paanchon bhujayein: 8 + 5 + 7 + 6 + 3 = 29 m. Ab tak samajh aaya?
drawing karke samjhao
Line par khet ki paanchon bhujayein usi kram mein hain jaise P se chalte hain: 8 m, 5 m, 7 m, 6 m aur 3 m. Yahan tak saaf hai?
pata nahi, aap batao

director.text: 15 centimetres

Haan, sahi hai: 4 + 5 + 6 = 15 cm, teeno bhujayein judi, koi nahi chhooti. Yeh hexagon hai, chhah bhujaon wala. Sab bhujayein barabar hain, par label sirf ek par hai: 5 cm. Baaki par kuch likha nahi, phir bhi woh kinaare mein aati hain. Parimap mein har bhuja aati hai, likhi ho ya na ho. Hexagon ki kitni bhujaon par label likha hai?
one side
Bilkul sahi. Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?
director.card: Poore hexagon ka parimap kitna hua?

director.text: Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki chhah bhujayein, har ek 5 cm ki: 6 × 5 = 30 cm. Ab yeh rectangle dekho, 6 cm lamba aur 4 cm chauda. Parimap ek dhaaga hai jo kinaare par chalta hai: pehle 6, phir bagal ki bhuja 4, phir 6, phir 4. Andar ki jagah area hai, woh bilkul alag cheez hai. Dhaaga kahan chalta hai, kinaare par ya andar?
mujhe nahi pata
Dhaaga kinaare par chalta hai. Kinaare par ek baar dhaaga lapetna hai. Kitna dhaaga lagega?

director.card: Kinaare par ek baar dhaaga lapetna hai. Kitna dhaaga lagega?

Chalo, ab ek sawaal hum dono saath mein karte hain. Phoolon ki ek kyari triangle jaisi hai, bhujayein 7 m, 9 m aur 12 m. Uske kinaare-kinaare ek baar baad lagani hai. Dekhte hain, kitni lambi baad lagegi. Baad kinaare par lagegi, toh teeno bhujayein jodni hain: P = 7 + 9 + 12, kyunki ek bhi bhuja chhooti toh baad mein wahan khaali jagah reh jaayegi. Pehle 7 aur 9 jodo: kitne metre hue?

seams.form: Chalo, ab ek sawaal hum dono saath mein karte hain.

director.text: Haan, 7 + 9 = 16 m; do bhujayein jud gayi. Teesri bhuja bachi, 12 m. 16 mein 12 jodo, kitna hua?

director.text: 16 m sahi nahi hai. 16 m mein abhi sirf do bhujayein hain, 7 m aur 9 m. Teesri bhuja 12 m bhi kinaare par hai, use bhi jodna hai. 16 mein 12 jodo, kitna hua?

Bilkul sahi, kyunki chaaron bhujayein judti hain: 9 + 6 + 7 + 4 = 26 m. Zoya ne 10 cm lambe, 4 cm chaude card ka parimap 10 × 4 = 40 cm nikala. Sahi parimap kitne centimetre hai?

director.text: Haan, bilkul theek. Dekho, parimap kinaara hai: 10 + 4 + 10 + 4 = 28 cm; 10 × 4 andar ki jagah hai. Seedhi bhujaon wali har shape mein har bhuja jodna chalta hai. Ab ek rectangle socho: iski bhujayein jodiyon mein aati hain, aur isse jodne ka ek jaldi wala tareeka milta hai. Yahan tak saaf hai?
thak gayi, bye
Thak jaana theek hai; thoda aaram karo aur paani pi lo. Aaj ke liye itna hi, phir milte hain.
